remarks: Welcome to this rarely available 2BR/2BA H-Line corner unit offering an exceptional combination of space, functionality & convenience in one of Stamford's most desirable condo communities. This well-maintained residence features a spacious layout w/oversized windows that fill the home with sunlight throughout the day. The over-sized LVRM flows into a large dining area, creating comfortable space for everyday living & entertaining. The space offers great potential to enlarge existing kitchen if desired. The sun-filled kitchen offers excellent natural light & the private screened balcony is the perfect place to relax with a cup of coffee or glass of wine. The primary suite features generous closet space & bath, while the spacious 2nd bdrm & hall bth provide flexibility for guests, a home office, or family. 1 deeded garage space included in maintenance, additional space can be rented for approx. $80/mo, based on availability. Residents enjoy a full-service concierge/sec, storage, laundry facilities on every floor, and new elevators. The outdoor pool is currently undergoing renovations and will reopen upon completion. Conveniently located on the east side of downtown Stamford, you're just minutes from restaurants, shopping, parks, & everyday conveniences. Stamford Metro-North is nearby, offering frequent express service to Grand Central Terminal in approximately 45 to 55 minutes, making this an excellent home for commuters and anyone looking to enjoy a low-maintenance lifestyle!
